BIO.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
BIO.rationale: Pharmacologic study metacognitive sensitivity versus mean-confidence null; sampling urgency modeled, not direct adequacy. No prescription/identity or BIO pilot work.

CUL.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
CUL.rationale: Authority-based legitimacy community norms versus perceived credibility; no culture-level causal estimate from source cue.

ENV.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
ENV.rationale: Environmental-risk information and school-water scenario studied; narrative about water scarcity not actual environmental exposure.

INF.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
INF.rationale: Argument content/quality, omission, disclosure, warning and feedback; content property and recipient response separate.

INS.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
INS.rationale: Authority credentials, scientific replication disclosure and institutional trust must reach recipient; no mandatory trust inference.

PSY.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
PSY.rationale: Confidence feedback, counterargument labels, motivation versus resistance outcomes and perceived adequacy considered.

SOC.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
SOC.rationale: Source-person trust and interpersonal learning versus general epistemic stance; no trust-game equivalence.

TEC.exactDriverLimit: Research-needed direct effect preserved; no signed effect or supported-zero inference.
TEC.rationale: AI trust/reliability, synthetic faces and interfaces; technical fidelity, source profile and modeled state distinct.

drivers.qualifiers: Reach, heterogeneity, intended/unintended effects, criterion-specific benefit, synergy/antagonism and actor/legal/ethical/applicability prerequisites considered. No recommendation eligibility.
